prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium social campaign card for BUY HARD, 1536 x 1024 landscape (3:2), suitable for X and LinkedIn. This is card 01 of a matching three-card series. The established brand is a flat pale acid-lime background (#dce985), near-black type (#171b12), bold large Swiss grotesk typography, small spaced monospaced labels, hairline black rules, square corners, plenty of breathing room. Editorial design with a tactile studio still life of everyday business supplies: a small stack of unbranded white paper cups, a kraft carton, and a roll of plain adhesive labels. Carefully art-directed, cut out against the same lime background, realistic material and soft directional shadow; objects occupy the lower-right half without crowding the headline. Black masthead at upper left: 'BUY HARD'. Exact large headline at left, on two lines: 'Meet your' / 'buyer.' Exact supporting line: 'Everyday supplies. One clear buying flow.' Small bottom-left line: 'EARLY PILOT · YOUR APPROVAL COMES FIRST'. Thin footer rule and a very readable sponsor credit line: 'Built with Convex · OpenAI · Firecrawl · AgentMail'. Small serial '01 / INTRODUCTION'. Make the title readable in a phone feed. High-end design, confident and simple. Do not add any other words. No screenshots, app windows, charts, numerical results, customer claims, fake logos, people, gradients, robots, watermarks or glossy 3D icons. Spell BUY HARD, OpenAI, Firecrawl and AgentMail exactly. All lettering must be crisp with wide safe margins.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium social campaign card for BUY HARD, 1536 x 1024 landscape (3:2), suitable for X and LinkedIn. This is card 02 of a matching three-card series. Established visual system: flat pale acid-lime (#dce985), near-black (#171b12), very large bold Swiss grotesk headline, small spaced monospaced labels, hairline rules, square corners, clean editorial layout and generous negative space. Top-left masthead 'BUY HARD'. Exact large headline, two lines on left: 'Just say' / 'what’s left.' Beneath it a distinct large white typographic quote panel with exact text: 'We have 8 cases of cups left.' This is an editorial quotation, not a screenshot or a simulated assistant response. In lower right, a tactile studio still life of a neat stack of unbranded white paper cups with soft side shadows on lime. Small supporting line: 'Update stock in a conversation.' Small attribution badge: 'POWERED BY OPENAI'. At bottom a thin black rule and readable credit: 'Built with Convex · OpenAI · Firecrawl · AgentMail'. Small evidence label 'WORKFLOW ILLUSTRATION'. Small serial '02 / OPENAI'. Make every line readable in a phone feed. Do not add any other words. No app interface, invented AI reply, success checkmark, provider receipt, live-call claim, performance metric, customer logos, robots, people, blue-purple glow or watermark. Crisp correct spelling and generous safe margins.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium social campaign card for BUY HARD, 1536 x 1024 landscape (3:2), suitable for X and LinkedIn. This is card 03 of a matching three-card series. Use the established visual system: flat pale acid-lime background (#dce985), near-black type (#171b12), huge bold Swiss grotesk headline, small spaced monospaced labels, hairline black rules, square corners, ample negative space. Top-left masthead 'BUY HARD'. Exact headline at left on two lines: 'Start with' / 'a link.' Exact supporting line: 'Product details, ready for review.' In the right and lower middle build a restrained editorial paper collage: a rectangular warm-white printed product-page card labeled 'PRODUCT PAGE' containing a beautiful studio photo of unbranded paper cups; a simple black arrow connects it to a second offset plain white information card labeled 'ITEM DETAILS' with the readable text 'Paper cups' and 'Review before adding'. A small black square link symbol connects the idea. These are clearly illustrative paper cards, not a screenshot or real supplier website. Small attribution badge: 'POWERED BY FIRECRAWL'. At the bottom a thin black rule and readable credit: 'Built with Convex · OpenAI · Firecrawl · AgentMail'. Small evidence label 'WORKFLOW ILLUSTRATION'. Small serial '03 / FIRECRAWL'. Use tactile paper, subtly realistic cutout edges and soft shadows with meticulous clean typography. Do not add other words, URLs, invented prices, supplier logos, testimonials, live-call claims, flame mascots, robots, neon gradients or watermarks. Spell all names exactly, maintain phone-feed readability and generous safe margins.
